## Feature Description
A clear and concise description of the feature or capability you are proposing.

## Problem Context & Motivation
What problem does this feature solve? How does it fit into the local-first meeting notetaking workflow?

## Proposed Technical Approach
- How should this be implemented?
- Which modules (`core/`, `ai/`, `export/`, `zoomrecorder_tui.py`) would be involved?
- Does this require additions or changes to `config.example.yaml`?

## Privacy & Offline Invariant Check
- [ ] Confirmed that this feature preserves the offline-first default (no external network calls without explicit opt-in).
- [ ] Confirmed that dual-channel audio separation is maintained.

## Additional Context
Add any other context, benchmarks, or mockups here.
